meta.source: Authored from the Design View 1 brief (employee Dynamic Knowledge Canvas), Oct 2026

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The canvas itself: the deepest layer every glass widget floats over. Never put text straight on it except the greeting.

tokens.name: ground-raised
tokens.usage: Solid insets inside widgets that must not show the canvas through them (document thumbnails' frame, input wells).

tokens.name: haze
tokens.usage: The canvas dot grid, skeleton widgets while cards assemble, inactive meters and avatar discs.

tokens.name: glass-100
tokens.usage: Level 1 glass: chips, kind badges, nested wells inside a card. Always with blur-glass behind it.

tokens.name: glass-200
tokens.usage: Level 2 glass: Action Cards, the Manager Dashboard dock, ambient widgets.

tokens.name: glass-300
tokens.usage: Level 3 glass: the omni-search bar and anything mid-flight. The nearest layer to the viewer.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: The 1px rim on every glass panel; it catches light, so it is lighter than the glass in both themes.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers inside glass: the line above the feedback bar, list separators in the dock.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on ground and every glass level.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: sources, metadata, idle feedback buttons, chips.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary text only: placeholders, the 'Did this get you ready?' prompt, step numbers. Still 4.5:1 on ground and glass.

tokens.name: ready
tokens.usage: The brand signal: submit, progress, Solved, focus. One mint thing per view should be the obvious next tap.

tokens.name: ready-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons sitting on a ready fill.

tokens.name: ready-soft
tokens.usage: Hover wash behind Solved; the ambient wash of a solved card.

tokens.name: escalate
tokens.usage: Hand-off to a human: the ticket, its flight trail, the dock counter. Never decorative: amber always means a person is now involved.

tokens.name: escalate-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an escalate fill (the ticket chip, the dock counter).

tokens.name: escalate-soft
tokens.usage: Hover wash behind Need human expert; the receipt left in a card's slot after escalation.

tokens.name: screen
tokens.usage: Media surfaces (the Video Player Card). Stays dark in both themes so video reads as a screen.

tokens.name: screen-ink
tokens.usage: Timecodes and controls drawn over a screen.

tokens.name: orb-a
tokens.usage: Ambient light behind the canvas, top-left. Blurred 80px+, never a shape you can see the edge of.

tokens.name: orb-b
tokens.usage: Ambient light behind the canvas, bottom-right, toward the Manager Dashboard.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus rings: 2px, offset 2px, on every interactive element.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The canvas greeting. Once per view, only while the canvas is empty.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Large figures in ambient widgets and empty states.

styles.name: omni
styles.sample: How do I get on the VPN on my first day?
styles.usage: Text typed into the omni-search bar.

styles.name: card-title
styles.sample: Day-1 setup: VPN, SSO and your laptop
styles.usage: Action Card titles; the dock title at 13px.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: VPN is required for finance, HR and source-code systems.
styles.usage: Card content: summary points, step labels, chapter names.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Card kind badges, feedback buttons, dock statuses.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Timecodes, page references, counts, keyboard hints.

styles.name: ticket-id
styles.usage: Ticket identifiers wherever a hand-off is shown.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label inside badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips; between feedback buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between rows inside a card (file row, ticket parts).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Section gap inside a card; header to body.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding; the gap between cards in the canvas grid.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Canvas edge inset for the top bar, dock and ambient widgets.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Greeting to omni bar.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: The omni bar's height at rest.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: File rows, icon tiles, keyboard hints.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Media inside a card (the video screen); the ticket chip.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Action Cards, the dock, ambient widgets.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Full-bleed sheets and modal layers.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: The omni bar, chips, feedback buttons, counters, toasts.

shadow.note: Each shadow includes a 1px inset top highlight: glass is lit from above.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Level 2 glass at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: A card under the pointer; the ticket in flight.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: The omni-search bar: the only thing that floats this high.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: Every glass panel: backdrop-filter blur(var(--blur-glass)) saturate(1.5).

tokens.name: blur-heavy
tokens.usage: The omni bar, so cards sliding under it never compete with what you type.

zIndex.note: The canvas is spatial: four named depths, nothing in between.

tokens.name: z-widget
tokens.usage: Action Cards and ambient widgets.

tokens.name: z-omni
tokens.usage: The omni-search bar.

tokens.name: z-dock
tokens.usage: The Manager Dashboard dock (it opens over cards).

tokens.name: z-flight
tokens.usage: The escalation flight overlay and toasts.
